title: 第八百八十章 劫后第八百七十九章 意外的援兵
lines: 眼见阿六那第二箭恰是错过了楚宽那自裁的匕首，皇帝一时面色遽变，疾掠上去时却已经来不及了。他一把抓住楚宽，怒喝了一声混账。然而，哪怕他怒气勃发，那个大多数时候都会面容沉静说一些认罪之语的童年玩伴，此时却只是空留一丝莫名微笑，竟是已然气绝。
除了之前那些话，竟是没有任何其他可以当成遗言的只言片语。
皇帝之前得到宫中钦天监观星台上的人禀报，声称张园之人莫名其妙在大白天放焰火，于是他觉得有些诡异，一时思忖无事，索性就微服匆匆出宫打算去看个究竟，谁知道在北安门遇上马车坏了，修车借车换车之后耽误许久方才得以回宫的永平公主。
听永平公主急急忙忙解释，说朱莹被清宁宫太后召见，张寿却表现异常，好似出了什么事，他干脆带上这女儿直奔张园，却发现这儿人竟是少了一大半。从一群懵懵懂懂只知道听命行事，于是大白天放焰火的小家伙那儿问明，朱泾约了张寿去白云观，他就觉得不对劲了。
自家女婿，在哪里说事情不方便，却偏偏要去什么白云观？于是，皇帝立时派了人去，召了一队锐骑营赶来了白云观。
而刚刚进来时，虽说只来得及赶上最后这场厮杀，但他已经意识到发生了什么事，因此皇帝甚至在心里发狠，定要严惩楚宽，以儆效尤，给朱泾和张寿翁婿一个交待……而由此想到一桩桩前事，他甚至想好，哪怕抛开旧情不顾，也要仔细对楚宽问个明白。
但此时此刻，他的脑袋却一片空白，眼前仿佛走马灯似的转过了一幕又一幕。
而下一刻，刚刚哪怕皇帝现身时却依旧没有停手的众多御前近侍，恰是齐齐束手就缚。可是，他们这停手实在是来得太快太突然，以至于对手们大多数收势不及，刀剑之下，一时间竟是有死有伤。可即便那些死伤之人，也只是发出低低的闷哼，却没有一个人求饶认罪。
足足好一会儿，皇帝方才从恍惚中回过神来。满手鲜血的他徐徐松开手，任由手中尸体滑落在地，随即抬头看向朱泾和张寿，一字一句地问道：“他到底都对你们说了些什么？”
张寿也没想到楚宽竟然如此决绝，然而更让他难以置信的是，阿六只拦住了那一剑，却没有挡住那一刀，因而此时他正在侧头看那面露懊丧的少年，竟没能第一时间回答皇帝的问题。然而，他会一时失神以至于忽视了天子，但赵国公朱泾却不会。
“莹莹，你把张寿带出去。”说完这话之后，朱泾也不管朱莹是答应还是不答应，又径直吩咐道，“其他人把楚宽带来的那些御前近侍也都带走，我有事单独禀告皇上。”
朱莹本来还想坚持，可见父亲那眼神中流露出了不容置疑的坚决，再加上看到张寿明显有些神思不属，她最终直接上前拖着张寿就往外走，可走了几步，她回过头瞧见阿六也在那发呆，当下就嗔道：“阿六，愣在这干什么，快来背着阿寿，你看他被吓得！”
阿六只微微一愣就赶忙过来，二话不说就把张寿背在了背上。可是，当他头也不回地跟着朱莹往外走时，却突然感觉到自己的耳朵被人狠狠揪了一下。虽说他从来都对疼痛很有抵抗力，可此时却禁不住嘶的一声倒吸一口凉气，继而就听到身后呵呵一声冷笑。
“你也知道疼？可你也不知道怕！”
知道是张寿已经恢复了清醒，阿六见朱莹仿佛没听见似的径直走在前头，他就小声说道：“少爷你说什么，我不明白。”
“还装傻？而且还是和我装？阿六，我和你一块相处那么多年了，你这点心思瞒得过我？你要是想拦住人，哪怕那是楚宽，他哪只手自裁，哪只手就绝对会中箭，你怎么可能失手！你以为皇上是傻子吗？”
阿六小声嘟囔道：“可他身上肯定还有毒药……嘴里肯定也有！”
“那你等到他服毒不就好了，用得着装什么失手？”张寿低低喝了一声，见前头的朱莹依旧仿佛什么都没听见似的，他不禁恼火地又拍了一记少年的脑袋，待想再训时，他就听到了少年那低低的声音，“就算要给他偿命，我也要杀了他！”
“谁让他想要杀你！”
张寿顿时被噎得无语，紧跟着，他就只见前头的朱莹竟是突然回转了过来，先是狠狠瞪了他一眼，随即就对着阿六问道：“小阿六，你老实告诉我，之前楚宽到底都说了些什么？”
“都是些疯话。”张寿实在没兴趣再提刚刚那些对话，尤其是知道阿六能够一字不漏复述对话过程的情况下。因此，他没有给阿六说话的机会，只是言简意赅地大致提了提，把重点落在楚宽怀疑自己生而知之这一点上。结果，他就只听朱莹恨恨骂了一声。
“简直荒谬！生而知之怎么了，这世上不是常有些志怪玄奇，说是某某转世到了某某身上，于是一个小孩子老气横秋地当人家老祖宗？读书人尚且会津津乐道记录这些东西，足可见这又不是什么特别稀奇的事，楚宽他吃饱了撑着吗？居然闲着没事干纠缠这些！”
而见朱莹压根不以为然，张寿不禁苦笑了一声，继而就岔开话题问道：“永平公主之前说你是被太后宣召入宫，看你这样子，是半路上就识破了？”
“最近乱七八糟的事情多，于是祖母和娘都千叮咛万嘱咐，让我千万小心，所以我就和玉泉姑姑事先约定了口信，宣召我入宫的时候一定要带上那几个字。那真的是清宁宫的内侍，编的理由也似模似样，可他说的宣召却没有那口信，我就动了疑心。”
“我还以为那是单纯有人想对我图谋不轨呢，所以悄悄让人给大哥送了口信，然后对那个家伙说，我要买东西带进宫献给太后，然后大哥守株待兔，直接设伏把人拿下了。那家伙难缠得很，一见不对就求死，真是什么将带什么兵，和楚宽一模一样！”
说到这里，朱莹忍不住恨恨地又骂了两句，随即却又微微扬了扬眉：“不过还是大哥厉害，他动作快，把那个求死的家伙给拦下了。后来他不知道用了什么手段问了话出来。”
content_en:
Seeing that Ah Liu's second arrow missed Chu Kuan's self-inflicted dagger, the emperor's expression suddenly changed, and when he swooped forward, it was already too late. He grabbed Chu Kuan and shouted angrily, "You bastard." However, even if he was furious, the childhood playmate who would have a calm face and said some words of apology most of the time, now had only an inexplicable smile, and was actually dead.
Apart from those words before, there were no other words that could be regarded as his last words.
The emperor had previously received a report from someone on the observatory of the Qintian Prison in the palace, claiming that people in Zhang Yuan were setting off fireworks for no apparent reason in broad daylight, so he felt a little weird. Thinking that nothing had happened, he simply left the palace in disguise and planned to see what was going on. Who knew that at Bei'anmen, he encountered Princess Yongping whose carriage was broken down, and it took a long time to repair and borrow a carriage before returning to the palace.
After hearing Princess Yongping's hurried explanation that Zhu Ying had been summoned by the Queen Mother of Qingning Palace, Zhang Shou acted strangely, as if something had happened. He simply took his daughter and went straight to Zhang Yuan, only to find that most of the people here were missing. After asking Zhang Shou to find out from a group of ignorant little guys who just followed orders and set off fireworks in broad daylight, he felt something was wrong after Zhu Jing made an appointment with Zhang Shou to go to Baiyun Temple.
My son-in-law, why did he say that things were inconvenient, but he decided to go to Baiyun Temple? So, the emperor immediately sent someone and summoned a team of sharp cavalry battalions to come to Baiyun Temple.
When he first came in, although he only had time to catch up with the last fight, he had already realized what had happened. Therefore, the emperor even felt cruel in his heart, and was determined to punish Chu Kuan severely, as a warning to others, and to give an explanation to Zhu Jing and Zhang Shouweng's son-in-law... From this, he thought of all the past events, and he even thought about asking Chu Kuan carefully even if he put aside the old relationship.
But at this moment, his mind was blank, and one scene after another passed before his eyes like a revolving lantern.
The next moment, many of the royal servants who had not stopped even when the emperor appeared just restrained their hands. However, their stoppage came so quickly and suddenly that most of their opponents were unable to stop their attacks in time. Under the sword, some were killed or injured in a short time. But even those who were killed or injured only made low groans, but no one begged for mercy and confessed.
After a long while, the emperor finally recovered from his trance. With his hands full of blood, he slowly let go and let the corpse fall to the ground. Then he looked up at Zhu Jing and Zhang Shou and asked word by word: "What did he say to you?"
Zhang Shou did not expect that Chu Kuan would be so decisive, but what made him even more unbelievable was that Ah Liu only blocked the sword, but not the sword. Therefore, at this time, he was looking sideways at the young man with a frustrated face, but he was unable to answer the emperor's question immediately. However, he would be so distracted that he ignored the emperor, but Zhu Jing, Duke of Zhao, would not.
"Yingying, take Zhang Shou out." After saying this, Zhu Jing did not care whether Zhu Ying agreed or not, and directly ordered, "Others, take away the imperial servants brought by Chu Kuan. I have something to report to the emperor alone."
Zhu Ying originally wanted to persist, but seeing the unquestionable determination in her father's eyes, and seeing that Zhang Shou was obviously distracted, she finally stepped forward and dragged Zhang Shou out, but after walking a few steps, she turned around and saw Ah Liu in a daze, and immediately said angrily: "Ah Liu, what are you doing standing here? Come and carry Ah Shou, you see he is scared!"
Ah Liu was slightly startled and hurried over, carrying Zhang Shou on his back without saying a word. However, when he followed Zhu Ying out without looking back, he suddenly felt his ear being tugged hard. Although he had always been very resistant to pain, at this moment he couldn't help but let out a hissing gasp, and then heard a sneer behind him.
"You know it hurts? But you don't know how to be afraid!"
Knowing that Zhang Shou had regained consciousness, Ah Liu saw Zhu Ying walking ahead as if she hadn't heard him. He whispered, "Master, what are you talking about? I don't understand."
"You are still pretending to be stupid? And you are still pretending to be with me? Ah Liu, I have been with you for so many years, how can you hide this idea from me? If you want to stop someone, even if it is Chu Kuan, he will definitely hit the arrow with whichever hand he kills. How could you miss! Do you think the emperor is a fool?"
Ah Liu muttered in a low voice: "But he must still have poison on his body... and in his mouth too!"
"Then why don't you just wait until he takes the poison? Why do you have to pretend to be a mistake?" Zhang Shou drank in a low voice. Seeing that Zhu Ying in front still seemed not to hear anything, he couldn't help but slapped the young man on the head again in annoyance. When he was about to train him again, he heard the young man's low voice, "Even if I have to pay for his life, I will kill him!"
"Who made him want to kill you!"
Zhang Shou was suddenly choked and speechless. Then, he saw Zhu Ying in front of him suddenly turned around. First she glared at him fiercely, and then asked Ah Liu: "Little Ah Liu, tell me honestly, what did Chu Kuan say before?"
"They're all crazy talk." Zhang Shou really had no interest in mentioning the conversation just now, especially knowing that Ah Liu could retell the conversation verbatim. Therefore, he did not give Ah Liu a chance to speak, but simply mentioned it briefly and concisely, focusing on the fact that Chu Kuan suspected that he was born with knowledge. As a result, he only heard Zhu Ying curse bitterly.
"It's ridiculous! What's wrong with being born with knowledge? Aren't there always some strange things in this world? It is said that someone is reincarnated into someone, so a child becomes someone's ancestor in an old-fashioned way? Scholars are willing to record these things, which shows that this is not a particularly unusual thing. Is Chu Kuan so full that he can hold on? He has nothing to do to bother with this!"
Seeing that Zhu Ying didn't take it seriously at all, Zhang Shou couldn't help but smile bitterly, and then changed the subject and asked: "Princess Yongping said before that you were summoned to the palace by the Queen Mother. Looking at you, did you find out halfway through?"
"There have been a lot of messy things recently, so my grandmother and my mother gave me many warnings and told me to be careful, so I made a message with Aunt Yuquan in advance, and I must include those words when summoning me to the palace. He was really a chamberlain of Qingning Palace, and the reason he made up was similar, but the message he said did not include that message, so I became suspicious."
"I thought it was just someone trying to do something bad to me, so I quietly sent a message to my eldest brother, and then told that guy that I wanted to buy something and bring it to the palace to present to the Queen Mother. Then my eldest brother just waited and laid an ambush to capture the person. That guy was very difficult to deal with. He wanted to die when he saw something was wrong. He really leads what kind of soldiers, just like Chu Kuan!"
Speaking of this, Zhu Ying couldn't help but cursed a few more words, and then raised her eyebrows slightly: "But the eldest brother is still awesome. He acted quickly and stopped the guy who was begging for death. Later, he didn't know what method he used to ask questions."
title_en: Chapter 880: After the Tribulation Chapter 879: Unexpected Reinforcements
